testsuite.name: com.textpic.studio.ime.KeyboardMetricsTest

testcase.name: all five height levels scale around the normal height
shift and backspace are 95 px, the letters between them 60 px
the whole keyboard is 0_71 of the width
landscape rows are shorter and stay inside the screen
row two starts half a key in from the left
a letter key is 60 px wide at 720 px
the side margin is 0_014 and the gap 0_0153 of the width
no key overlaps and every gap still hits a key
every page keeps the same height and the same margins
the keys sit above the navigation bar inside the view
a key is 83 px tall and rows are 104 px apart
the space bar takes the rest of the bottom row
the navigation bar inset is added below the keys
